task: FV2-027 — VAD sensitivity persistence after account/session restoration
summary: The reported Android login error on VAD sensitivity change was reproduced on the previously installed package and did not reproduce after installing signed arm64 Release APK 1.0.35+2068 built from current source. The active Flutter source already contains account-scoped lazy preference loading and restored-account preparation fixes. macOS Debug also changed and restored the threshold without an error.

checks.name: Android previous-install reproduction
checks.observation: On Android Emulator API 35, changing the sensitivity slider displayed 'Сначала войдите в аккаунт.' and left the threshold at −50 dBFS. Package version was 1.0.34, versionCode 2067. No voice channel was joined and the microphone remained off.

checks.name: Focused account-preference regression test
checks.observation: Loads the current signed-in account audio preferences before saving a sensitivity change; value and manual gain are retained.

checks.name: Current-source signed Android Release build
checks.command: cd clients/flutter && flutter build apk --release --target-platform android-arm64 --split-per-abi --no-pub
checks.observation: Built arm64 Release APK, 19.8 MB, versionName 1.0.35/versionCode 2068.

checks.name: Signer match and in-place update
checks.observation: Installed and newly built APK signer SHA-256 fingerprints matched. `adb install -r` succeeded; app data was not cleared and the existing workspace session returned after launch.

checks.name: Android current-source sensitivity change and restore
checks.observation: On signed APK 1.0.35+2068, installed in place over the existing app, the threshold changed from −50 to −48 dBFS without a login/error banner, then returned to −50 dBFS. The mic stayed off and no voice session was started. Screenshots: /tmp/boohtacord-android-1.0.35-adjusted.png and /tmp/boohtacord-android-1.0.35-restored.png.

checks.name: macOS Debug sensitivity change and restore
checks.observation: On the already-running macOS client, the threshold changed from −50 to −48 dBFS and was restored to −50 dBFS. No 'выйдите в аккаунт' error appeared; no restart or Keychain prompt occurred.

relevant_fixes_already_in_source: 8fe7d23d — load audio settings on session restore

limitations: The Android Release is published by GitHub Actions after pushing tag android-v1.0.35; no APK binary is committed to the repository.
status: PASS — current-source Android and macOS sensitivity behavior verified; broader FE-70 remains open
